# dsh-plugin-undermind
English | 中文

Undermind is an AI literature search service: you describe a
research goal in plain language, and it

returns papers ranked by relevance, plus PDF reading
and a workspace to keep them in.

This plugin brings Undermind's remote MCP server
(`https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp`) into
DeepSeek Harn

ess (`dsh`), so the agent can
search the literature, read PDFs and organize what it finds.
## Why this is a plugin and not just an MCP server entry

Undermind's endpoint accepts only `Authorization: Bearer`, issued through OAuth authorization
code +

PKCE (public client, no secret). The access token lives one hour, and the refresh token
rotates on

every use. dsh's built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` forwards static headers and
has no renewal l
ogic, so it cannot hold this connection. This plugin owns it instead:

- **OAuth/PKCE login** — a one-shot loopback callback server plus the system browser.
- **Token stor

age and refresh** — `$DSH_HOME/storages/undermind-mcp-auth.json`, written `0600`
and atomically repl

aced. The token is refreshed 90 seconds before expiry; a `401` triggers a
forced refresh and one ret

ry; a rotated refresh token is persisted immediately.
- **MCP session handling** — `initialize` → `n

otifications/initialized`, then
`mcp-session-id` on every call, JSON or `text/event-stream` response

s, and a fresh session
when the server returns `404`.
- **Tool registration** — everything `tools/li

st` returns is registered with dsh as
`mcp__undermind__<name>`. Nothing is registered while unauthor

ized, and changing the account
or client id drops the previous generation of tools.
- **`undermind_a

uth` tool** — `status`, `login`, `logout`, `refresh`, `retry`; always available
to the agent, so a s

ession can be repaired from chat.
- **Host HTTP routes** under `/dsh-undermind/api/` for browser-sid

e authorization and
diagnostics.
## Requirements

1. **An Undermind account.** Each user authorizes with their own account; there is no API key or
ser

vice-account mode.
2. **A client id.** Undermind does not support Dynamic Client Registration. It ac

mode.
2. **A client id.** Undermind does not support Dynamic Client Registration. It accepts either:

- **CIMD** — an HTTPS URL serving a Client ID Metadata Document (JSON), which Undermind
fetches; or

- a **pre-registered client id**, requested from
`support@undermind.ai`.

CIMD is the self-service path. Host this document at any HTTPS URL you control, then put that
URL in

self-service path. Host this document at any HTTPS URL you control, then put that
URL in `clientId`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The URL must serve `application/json`. GitHub's `raw.githubusercontent.com` serves
`text/plain`, so

a Gist needs a JSON-serving mirror (a `gist.githack.com` raw URL works);
GitHub Pages works as-is. `

client_id` must be byte-identical to the URL, and `redirect_uris`
must contain the plugin's `redirec
tUri` — update both together if you move the document.
`GET /dsh-undermind/api/client-metadata` prints the template with the current `redirectUri`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Replace `web` with your profile name. The package is plain ESM with no build step, and declares
`@de

epseek-ai/cordis` / `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` as peer dependencies so it shares the host's
copies i
nstead of bundling its own.

Profiles owned by the desktop client are special: `desktop` is reserved by Electron, and the
`dsh pl

ugin` CLI declines it. There, install from the plugin market, or place the package under
`profiles/d
esktop/node_modules` and add `dsh-plugin-undermind` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

Do **not** also add `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` for this server — it cannot refresh tokens,
and it
s tool names would collide with this plugin's.
## Configure
Every field is read live; saving in the plugin settings applies on the next call, no restart.
| Field | Default | Purpose |

| `clientId` | *(empty)* | **Required.** The CIMD HTTPS URL, or a pre-registered client id. |
| `mcp

Url` | `https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp` | MCP endpoint; also sent as the OAuth `resource`. |
| `scope`

| `mcp` | Requested scope. |
| `redirectUri` | `http://127.0.0.1:8799/callback` | Loopback callback

; must be registered in the client document. |
| `authorizeEndpoint` | `https://api.undermind.ai/o/a

uthorize/` | Authorization endpoint. |
| `tokenEndpoint` | `https://api.undermind.ai/o/token/` | Tok

en endpoint. |
| `revocationEndpoint` | `https://api.undermind.ai/o/revoke_token/` | Revocation endp

oint, called on logout. |
| `tokenFile` | *(empty)* | Empty means `$DSH_HOME/storages/undermind-mcp-

auth.json`. |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request MCP timeout. |
| `toolTimeoutMs` | `18000

0` | Per tool call; deep searches and PDF reading are slow. |
| `loginTimeoutMs` | `600000` | How lo

ng to wait for the browser round trip. |
| `toolPrefix` | `mcp__undermind__` | Prefix for the regist

ered tool names. |
| `disabledTools` | `[]` | Raw Undermind tool names to hide, e.g. `["write_file"]

tool names. |
| `disabledTools` | `[]` | Raw Undermind tool names to hide, e.g. `["write_file"]`. |
## Use
### First login
Ask the agent to connect Undermind, or call the tool yourself:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The plugin starts a one-shot server on the `redirectUri` port, builds the authorization URL
with `st

ate` and PKCE, and opens it in the default browser. After you approve, the browser lands
on `127.0.0

.1:8799/callback`; the plugin exchanges the code, writes the token, then lists and
registers the too

ls. `mcp__undermind__*` becomes visible to the model immediately —
`undermind_auth action="status"`
reports `toolCount` and the registered names.
### Day to day

- "Search the literature on magnesium battery electrolytes since 2024" →
`mcp__undermind__launch_dee

p_search` launches an asynchronous deep search (several minutes);
poll it with `inspect_deep_searche

s`.
- "Find papers similar to this abstract" → `mcp__undermind__search_papers`.
[该节后续省略]
## Security

- Tokens never leave the machine: they are written under `$DSH_HOME/storages/` with mode `0600`
and

an atomic replace.
- The token is sent only to `api.undermind.ai` and `mcp.undermind.ai`.
- The call

back server binds loopback, accepts a single authorization code, then closes.
- You can revoke the c
onnection at any time in your Undermind account settings.
